name: Limited Speed Motorcycle
description: A moped or scooter: a motorcycle with a power source of no more than 1.5 kW (or an engine of 50 cc or less), no clutching or shifting, a top speed of 70 km/h on level ground and a weight of 95 kg or less; an electric moped or scooter past the e-bike limits but within these lands here.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle: two or three wheels and a seat the rider sits astride
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1; Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 1

restrictions.rule: A power source producing no more than 1.5 kW, or an engine of no more than 50 cc
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No clutching or shifting once the drive system is engaged, a top speed of 70 km/h on level ground with or without pedals, no more than 95 kg excluding batteries or fuel, and wheels at least 254 mm in diameter
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 5 or 7 driver's licence, or a motorcycle licence
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 30.01(2)

restrictions.rule: The province and ICBC say a Class 5 or 7 learner's licence won't do
A motorcycle licence earned on a limited speed motorcycle covers only limited speed motorcycles
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 30.12(1)

restrictions.rule: Rider and any passenger must wear a motorcycle safety helmet
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 194(3)

restrictions.rule: Registered, licensed and insured with ICBC like any motor vehicle
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 3(1)

restrictions.rule: Ridden only where motor vehicles may go: not in cycle lanes
One past these limits is a motorcycle that needs a motorcycle licence
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1; Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, ss. 1 and 30.01(2)
